deviations.what: The base expansion uses year = fy + 0:(base_years - 1), so a patent filed in fy counts toward focal years fy to fy+4 instead of fy+1 to fy+5, leaving B(i,t) covering filing years t-4 to t rather than t-5 to t-1.
Because of the same offset, patents filed in focal year t itself enter the base set B(i,t), although the spec says year t belongs to neither window.

notes: Dating, the forward window (line 13), class selection, missing-class handling, the NA rule for an empty base, the zero rule for no forward patents, firm separation, de-duplication and output columns all match the spec. The single root cause is the base offset at line 12, which also breaks the spec's test that adding a patent filed in year t changes nothing for focal year t.
